title: centaurea scabiosa var. cephalariifolia
intro: Centaurea scabiosa var. cephalariifolia, commonly known as Cephalaria, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) characterized by its bright blue or purple flowers and fern-like foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Cephalaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
